heuristics.statement: The number of centres c in F_p with 1 <= k(c) <= 16 is at least 0.30 p, where k(c) is the number of nonzero squares S with g_c(S) = 0 (the degree of gcd(g_c, S^((p-1)/2) - 1)), for the line of proof Section 1 at this round count.
heuristics.scope: poseidon-orchard-r5-prefix-v1, the line of proof Section 1 (lane 0 constant at the round-1 S-box input), centres uniform on F_p.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the hyperoctahedral Poisson(1/2) law (P(k >= 1) = 0.39347) and from k(c) counts at small degree on this line to degree m of this round count.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved at this degree; false for permutation polynomials and decomposable F with imprimitive monodromy; the small-degree counts test degrees 12 and 62 only.

heuristics.statement: The remainder sequence of (g_c, Y - 1) is normal down to deg G, so the half-gcd executes at most the schedule charged in proof Section 5; the time bound is conditional on it.
heuristics.scope: The cost of the gcd stage of this package.
heuristics.extrapolation: From the normal-sequence observations of the organizer experiments on this line at two and three S-box layers (degrees 12 and 62), the mock-versus-executed validation at degrees up to 39062 (including instances with deg G from 3 to 9) and the executed r = 1, 2, 3 runs to degree m.
heuristics.limitations: On a non-normal sequence the gcd is still correct but its cost differs from the charged schedule.

heuristics.statement: Prices of proof Section 3.0: field operations 1, loads and stores 2 (access and address), loops 3 per iteration (unrolled by 8 where streaming) plus 2 per exit, a declared 16-word register file, and a 1 MiB allowance for code, constants, registers and stack.
heuristics.scope: The time and memory claims of this package.
heuristics.limitations: The contract fixes no register count or code-size rule; the allowance is a declared bound, not a measured binary.
